title: Design System: Nicolas Rabelo de Melo — Torre Arcana

display.purpose: Boot/recognition ritual text, panel/dossier titles. Arcane purple by default, overridden by the panel's own accent.

body.purpose: Dossier panel paragraph copy — the only serif in the build, reserved for reading.

label.purpose: System chrome only: corner readouts, panel kickers, tag chips, button text, hotspot tags.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts the dossier modal off the dimmed backdrop. Reserved for this one surface.

shadows.name: boot-title-bloom
shadows.purpose: Text-shadow bloom on the boot/recognition ritual text.

motion.name: hotspot-fade
motion.purpose: Hotspot label visibility transition as the camera/projection updates.

motion.name: door-recognition-reveal
motion.value: camera dolly 2200ms ease-out-cubic, door hinge rotation eased in lockstep
motion.purpose: The intro's one authored motion: after a held beat on the closed door, the door swings open on its hinge while the camera pulls back to the wide idle framing. Not reused elsewhere.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Flat outlined link/button used for CTAs (project links, contact links, CV download, panel close). Becomes a gold pill inside the contato panel only.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #cab8ff; border: 1px solid #4a3a8a; padding: 9px 14px; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #d8ad5a; color: #d8ad5a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d8ad5a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Inline label used for skills, certifications, and tag rows. Becomes a rotated parchment sticky note inside the sobre panel only.
components.css: .ds-chip-tag { font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; border: 1px solid #4a3a8a; color: #cab8ff; padding: 3px 8px; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Dossier Panel
components.description: Centered modal used for all four content sections (Projetos, Experiência, Sobre mim, Contato), opened from a hotspot click. Background gradient and accent color swap per data-theme to match the 3D object that opened it.

components.css: .ds-panel { width: min(760px, 92vw); max-height: min(78vh, 720px); overflow-y: auto; background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% -10%, #2a1a4a 0%, #1a1322 55%, #0e0a16 100%); border: 1px solid #4a3a8a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(154,123,255,0.1), 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); padding: 26px 28px 30px; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #4a3a8a; padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-panel-kicker { font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; color: #4a3a8a; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'MedievalSharp', cursive; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.4rem); color: #cab8ff; margin: 2px 0 0; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-panel-close { font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #4a3a8a; color: #cab8ff; padding: 6px 12px; } .ds-panel-close:hover { border-color: #d8ad5a; color: #d8ad5a; }

components.name: Hotspot Label
components.description: Screen-projected clickable marker over a 3D world object; pin dot + uppercase tag.
components.css: .ds-hotspot { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-hotspot-pin { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #9a7bff; box-shadow: 0 0 8px 2px rgba(154,123,255,0.8); } .ds-hotspot-tag { font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #cab8ff; background: rgba(12,9,18,0.78); border: 1px solid #4a3a8a; padding: 4px 10px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-hotspot:hover .ds-hotspot-tag, .ds-hotspot:focus-visible .ds-hotspot-tag { border-color: #d8ad5a; color: #d8ad5a; }

components.name: Pinned Note Chip (sobre panel)
components.description: The sobre panel's own override of Tag Chip — a solid parchment-colored sticky note with a slight rotation, cycling through 6 warm tones, no border.
components.css: .ds-note-chip { font-family: 'IM Fell English', serif; font-size: 12.5px; color: #2a2015; background: #e8d9a8; padding: 5px 10px; display: inline-block; box-shadow: 1px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); transform: rotate(-2deg); }

components.name: Log Entry
components.description: Left-rule record block used for projects, experience, and education entries inside dossier panels.
components.css: .ds-entry { border-left: 1px solid #4a3a8a; padding-left: 14px; margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-entry-title { font-weight: 700; color: #cab8ff; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; } .ds-entry-meta { font-size: 12px; color: #d8ad5a; margin: 2px 0 8px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; }

narrative.overview: The build is a fixed-camera Three.js room at the top of a stone tower — real photographed stone and wood PBR surfaces, a hand-built four-poster bed, a brass-caged crystal orb, a scrying mirror, a grimoire on a lectern — rendered through a hand-rolled post-process composer (bright-pass + two-pass Gaussian blur bloom, warm vignette, gentle candle-flicker, film grain) built from render targets, with no three/examples/jsm loaders in the shader path. The DOM overlay (recognition boot screen, hotspot labels, dossier panels, corner chrome) never pretends to be a physical object; it reads as handwriting and candlelight laid over the 3D viewport. Arcane purple is the committed interaction color, carried as glow/emissive/text-shadow rather than flat fills; warm gold stands in for candlelight and secondary emphasis. The room's geometry and real-world textures carry color and material; the UI layer carries light and ink. This is a code-led, near-zero external-asset build: procedural canvas textures and Three.js materials for everything except a handful of CC0 stone/wood photographs and five tiny CC0 prop models (see ASSETS_CREDITS.md).
keyCharacteristics: Arcane purple glow as the dominant interactive signal; warm gold as the secondary candlelight/CTA accent
A warm flicker-and-grain atmosphere composite (no scanlines, no chromatic aberration) layered over every frame, DOM included
Flat, zero-radius rectangular UI chrome as default, with two confirmed exceptions: the circular hotspot pin and the contato panel's pill buttons
MedievalSharp display, IM Fell English body, Share Tech Mono label — a scholar's hand plus one precise instrument, never generic system sans
Each of the four dossier panels is skinned to the object that opened it, not a reused template

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: Arcane purple never appears as a flat background or solid button fill. It is always carried by emissive material, box-shadow glow, or text-shadow bloom — light, not paint.

rules.name: The Panel-Matches-the-Prop Rule
rules.body: A dossier panel's accent color follows the 3D object that opens it: experiencia runs cool blue, sobre runs warm parchment gold with sticky-note chips, contato keeps gold but turns its buttons into pills, and only projetos keeps the default arcane-purple treatment. A new panel picks its accent from its object, never defaults to purple by habit.

rules.name: The Hand-Plus-Instrument Rule
rules.body: No system UI sans anywhere in the build. Reading copy always routes through IM Fell English; system chrome always routes through Share Tech Mono; only titles and the boot ritual use MedievalSharp.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Outside the single dossier-panel modal, DOM depth comes from arcane/gold glow only, never from a generic drop-shadow card system.

dos: Do carry arcane purple as glow/emissive (text-shadow, box-shadow, material emissive), never as a flat fill — The Glow-Not-Fill Rule.
Do let each dossier panel's accent color follow the 3D object that opens it, per The Panel-Matches-the-Prop Rule.
Do keep all DOM chrome flat and zero-radius, with only the two confirmed exceptions (hotspot pin, contato pill buttons).
Do route body copy through IM Fell English and system chrome through Share Tech Mono — The Hand-Plus-Instrument Rule.
Do keep new 3D props and external assets CC0/credited and small (see ASSETS_CREDITS.md).
donts: Don't add a generic drop-shadow card-elevation system; DOM depth outside the dossier modal comes from glow only.
Don't add scanline, chromatic-aberration, or CRT-style post-processing — that identity was explicitly retired when the theme moved from a vault terminal to this tower.
Don't add border-radius to DOM UI chrome beyond the two confirmed exceptions.
Don't introduce new kicker/eyebrow micro-labels beyond the panel kicker already in use.
